verses.original: Τί οὖν τὸ περισσὸν τοῦ Ἰουδαίου ἢ τίς ἡ ὠφέλεια τῆς περιτομῆς
verses.transliteration: Ti oun to perisson tou Ioudaiou ē tis hē ōpheleia tēs peritomēs
verses.literal: What then [is] the advantage of [being] a Jew Or what [is] the value - of circumcision

verses.original: πολὺ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον γὰρ μὲν πρῶτον ὅτι ἐπιστεύθησαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: poly kata panta tropon gar men prōton hoti episteuthēsan ta logia tou Theou
verses.literal: Much in every way vvv vvv First of all - they have been entrusted with the very words - of God

verses.original: Τί εἰ γάρ τινες ἠπίστησάν αὐτῶν ἡ ἀπιστία μὴ καταργήσει τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: Ti ei gar tines ēpistēsan autōn hē apistia mē katargēsei tou Theou tēn pistin
verses.literal: What if - some did not have faith {Will} their - lack of faith vvv nullify - God’s - faithfulness

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο δὲ ὁ Θεὸς γινέσθω ἀληθής δὲ πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης καθὼς γέγραπται Ὅπως ἂν δικαιωθῇς ἐν σου τοῖς λόγοις καὶ νικήσεις ἐν σε τῷ κρίνεσθαί
verses.transliteration: mē genoito de ho Theos ginesthō alēthēs de pas anthrōpos pseustēs kathōs gegraptai Hopōs an dikaiōthēs en sou tois logois kai nikēseis en se tō krinesthai
verses.literal: vvv Certainly not - - {Let} God be true and every man a liar As it is written - So that You may be proved right when You - speak and victorious when You - judge

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ ἡμῶν ἡ ἀδικία συνίστησιν δικαιοσύνην Θεοῦ τί ἐροῦμεν ὁ Θεὸς μὴ ἄδικος ὁ ἐπιφέρων τὴν ὀργήν λέγω κατὰ ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: de Ei hēmōn hē adikia synistēsin dikaiosynēn Theou ti eroumen ho Theos mē adikos ho epipherōn tēn orgēn legō kata anthrōpon
verses.literal: But if our - unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God what shall we say [That] God [is] unjust - to inflict [His] wrath [on us] I am speaking in human terms

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο ἐπεὶ πῶς ὁ Θεὸς κρινεῖ τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: mē genoito epei pōs ho Theos krinei ton kosmon
verses.literal: vvv Certainly not In that case how - {could} God judge the world

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἡ ἐν ἐμῷ τῷ ψεύσματι ἐπερίσσευσεν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλήθεια εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν δόξαν τί κἀγὼ ἔτι κρίνομαι ὡς ἁμαρτωλὸς
verses.transliteration: de ei hē en emō tō pseusmati eperisseusen tou Theou alētheia eis autou tēn doxan ti kagō eti krinomai hōs hamartōlos
verses.literal: However if - - my - falsehood accentuates - God’s truthfulness to the increase of His - glory why {am} I still condemned as a sinner

verses.original: καὶ μὴ καθὼς καθώς τινες βλασφημούμεθα καὶ φασίν ἡμᾶς λέγειν ὅτι Ποιήσωμεν κακὰ τὰ ἵνα τὰ ἀγαθά ἔλθῃ ὧν τὸ κρίμα ἐστιν ἔνδικόν
verses.transliteration: kai mē kathōs kathōs tines blasphēmoumetha kai phasin hēmas legein hoti Poiēsōmen kaka ta hina ta agatha elthē hōn to krima estin endikon
verses.literal: [Why] not [say] as - some slanderously - claim [that] we say - Let us do evil - that - good may result Their - condemnation is deserved

verses.original: Τί οὖν προεχόμεθα οὐ πάντως γὰρ προῃτιασάμεθα Ἰουδαίους καὶ Ἕλληνας τε εἶναι πάντας ὑφ’ ἁμαρτίαν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun proechometha ou pantōs gar proētiasametha Ioudaious kai Hellēnas te einai pantas hyph’ hamartian
verses.literal: What then Are we any better Not at all For we have already made the charge [that] Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι ἔστιν Οὐκ δίκαιος οὐδὲ εἷς
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai hoti estin Ouk dikaios oude heis
verses.literal: As it is written - There is no one righteous not even one

verses.original: ἔστιν οὐκ ὁ συνίων ἔστιν οὐκ ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: estin ouk ho syniōn estin ouk ho ekzētōn ton Theon
verses.literal: There is no one who understands - no one who seeks - God

verses.original: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν ἔστιν οὐκ ὁ ποιῶν χρηστότητα ἔστιν οὐκ ἕως ἑνός
verses.transliteration: pantes exeklinan hama ēchreōthēsan estin ouk ho poiōn chrēstotēta estin ouk heōs henos
verses.literal: All have turned away vvv they have together become worthless there is no one who does good - not even one

verses.original: αὐτῶν ὁ λάρυγξ ἀνεῳγμένος τάφος ταῖς αὐτῶν γλώσσαις ἐδολιοῦσαν ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ αὐτῶν τὰ χείλη
verses.transliteration: autōn ho larynx aneōgmenos taphos tais autōn glōssais edoliousan ios aspidōn hypo autōn ta cheilē
verses.literal: Their - throats [are] open graves - their tongues practice deceit [The] venom of vipers [is] on their - lips

verses.original: ὧν τὸ στόμα γέμει ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας
verses.transliteration: hōn to stoma gemei aras kai pikrias
verses.literal: [Their] - mouths are full of cursing and bitterness

verses.original: αὐτῶν οἱ πόδες ὀξεῖς ἐκχέαι αἷμα
verses.transliteration: autōn hoi podes oxeis ekcheai haima
verses.literal: Their - feet [are] swift to shed blood

verses.original: σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς ὁδοῖς
verses.transliteration: syntrimma kai talaipōria en autōn tais hodois
verses.literal: ruin and misery [lie] in their - wake

verses.original: καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν
verses.transliteration: kai hodon eirēnēs ouk egnōsan
verses.literal: and [the] way of peace vvv they have not known

verses.original: ἔστιν οὐκ φόβος Θεοῦ ἀπέναντι αὐτῶν τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν
verses.transliteration: estin ouk phobos Theou apenanti autōn tōn ophthalmōn
verses.literal: There is no fear of God before their - eyes

verses.original: δὲ Οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὅσα ὁ νόμος λέγει λαλεῖ τοῖς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ἵνα πᾶν στόμα φραγῇ καὶ ὁ πᾶς κόσμος γένηται ὑπόδικος τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de Oidamen hoti hosa ho nomos legei lalei tois en tō nomō hina pan stoma phragē kai ho pas kosmos genētai hypodikos tō Theō
verses.literal: Now we know that whatever the law says it says to those who are under the law so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world - held accountable - to God

verses.original: διότι οὐ πᾶσα σὰρξ δικαιωθήσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου γὰρ νόμου διὰ ἐπίγνωσις ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: dioti ou pasa sarx dikaiōthēsetai enōpion autou ex ergōn nomou gar nomou dia epignōsis hamartias
verses.literal: Therefore no one . . . will be justified in His sight . . . by works of the law For [the] law merely brings awareness of sin

verses.original: δὲ Νυνὶ χωρὶς νόμου δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ πεφανέρωται μαρτυρουμένη ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: de Nyni chōris nomou dikaiosynē Theou pephanerōtai martyroumenē hypo tou nomou kai tōn prophētōn
verses.literal: But now apart from [the] law [the] righteousness of God has been revealed as attested by the Law and the Prophets

verses.original: δὲ δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ διὰ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς πάντας τοὺς πιστεύοντας γάρ ἐστιν οὐ διαστολή
verses.transliteration: de dikaiosynē Theou dia pisteōs Iēsou Christou eis pantas tous pisteuontas gar estin ou diastolē
verses.literal: And [this] righteousness [from] God [comes] through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe - There is no distinction

verses.original: γὰρ πάντες ἥμαρτον καὶ ὑστεροῦνται τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar pantes hēmarton kai hysterountai tēs doxēs tou Theou
verses.literal: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory - of God

verses.original: δικαιούμενοι δωρεὰν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι διὰ τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: dikaioumenoi dōrean tē autou chariti dia tēs apolytrōseōs tēs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: [and are] justified freely by His grace through the redemption that [is] in Christ Jesus

verses.original: Θεὸς προέθετο ὃν ὁ ἱλαστήριον ἐν αὐτοῦ τῷ αἵματι διὰ τῆς πίστεως εἰς ἔνδειξιν αὐτοῦ τῆς δικαιοσύνης διὰ ἐν τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀνοχῇ τὴν πάρεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτημάτων προγεγονότων
verses.transliteration: Theos proetheto hon ho hilastērion en autou tō haimati dia tēs pisteōs eis endeixin autou tēs dikaiosynēs dia en tē tou Theou anochē tēn paresin tōn hamartēmatōn progegonotōn
verses.literal: God presented [Him] - [as an] atoning sacrifice in His - blood through - faith in order to demonstrate His - righteousness because in - [His] forbearance - [He] had passed over the sins committed beforehand

verses.original: πρὸς τὴν ἔνδειξιν τῆς αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνης ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ εἰς αὐτὸν τὸ εἶναι δίκαιον καὶ δικαιοῦντα τὸν ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros tēn endeixin tēs autou dikaiosynēs en tō nyn kairō eis auton to einai dikaion kai dikaiounta ton ek pisteōs Iēsou
verses.literal: [He did this] - to demonstrate - His righteousness at the present time so as - - to be just and to justify the [one] [who has] faith in Jesus

verses.original: Ποῦ οὖν ἡ καύχησις ἐξεκλείσθη διὰ ποίου νόμου τῶν ἔργων οὐχί ἀλλὰ διὰ νόμου πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Pou oun hē kauchēsis exekleisthē dia poiou nomou tōn ergōn ouchi alla dia nomou pisteōs
verses.literal: Where then, [is] - boasting It is excluded On what principle [On] that of works No but on [that] of faith

verses.original: γὰρ λογιζόμεθα ἄνθρωπον δικαιοῦσθαι πίστει χωρὶς ἔργων νόμου
verses.transliteration: gar logizometha anthrōpon dikaiousthai pistei chōris ergōn nomou
verses.literal: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law

verses.original: Ἢ ὁ Θεὸς Ἰουδαίων μόνον οὐχὶ ἐθνῶν καὶ ναὶ ἐθνῶν καὶ
verses.transliteration: Ē ho Theos Ioudaiōn monon ouchi ethnōn kai nai ethnōn kai
verses.literal: - [Is God] the God of Jews only [Is He] not [the God] of Gentiles too Yes of Gentiles too

verses.original: εἴπερ εἷς ὁ Θεός ὃς δικαιώσει περιτομὴν ἐκ πίστεως καὶ ἀκροβυστίαν διὰ τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: eiper heis ho Theos hos dikaiōsei peritomēn ek pisteōs kai akrobystian dia tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: since [there is only] one - God who will justify [the] circumcised by faith and [the] uncircumcised through that [same] faith

verses.original: οὖν καταργοῦμεν Νόμον διὰ τῆς πίστεως μὴ γένοιτο ἀλλὰ ἱστάνομεν νόμον
verses.transliteration: oun katargoumen Nomon dia tēs pisteōs mē genoito alla histanomen nomon
verses.literal: vvv Do we, then, nullify [the] law by [this] faith vvv Certainly not Instead we uphold [the] law
